_comment: Maps a package name to the SHA-256 hash(es) of its legitimate signing certificate(s). If a scanned APK claims one of these package names but is signed by a different certificate, it is almost certainly a repackaged / trojanised build and is flagged. Fill this with certificates you have verified yourself (e.g. via `apksigner verify --print-certs` on a Play-store copy). The entries below are placeholders.
_format: sha256 of the DER-encoded signing certificate, lowercase hex
